typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk (or Outfit) - clean, structural, yet modern and friendly
typography.body: Inter - for maximum legibility in POS and data-dense Admin dashboards
rules: Use tracking-tight for all headings above 32px
Do NOT exceed text-6xl for hero headings
Use uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-widest) for tiny overlines and labels

colors.archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY meets PASTEL & SOFT (Aquatic Vibe)
rules: Never use pure black or pure white; tint with a drop of blue (e.g., #0F172A for dark text)
Avoid teal green/blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards per constraints, rely on pure cyan or deep oceanic blue
CTAs should be high contrast (Action Orange) to stand out against blue/white aquatic backgrounds
No complete transparent backgrounds for overlays/dropdowns. Use solid white with shadow or glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl).

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly on sticky headers or floating POS panels. bg-white/80 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-white/20.
visual_enhancers.neumorphism: Not recommended for this theme to maintain crispness in wet environments.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200 for cards, keeping it flat and clean.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient soft shadows (shadow-sm or shadow-md) for cards, drop-shadow-xl for floating action buttons.

grids.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-6.
grids.marketing: The 'Bento' Grid for landing/ticketing pages. Wide gaps (gap-8).

layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar navigation with dense data widgets and Shadcn charts. Quick-action top bar.
layouts.pos_interface: Touch-friendly. Thumb-aligned large action buttons (min 44px height). Grid layout for snacks/add-ons.
layouts.online_checkout: Step-by-step, clean, minimal friction, progress indicator, trust badges.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all buttons (slight lift -translate-y-1, increased shadow).
motion.micro_interactions: Soft checkmarks upon task completion (e.g., locker assigned).

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg (8px), no sharp edges for consumer-facing, crisp edges for admin.
components.cards: Subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius), flat with 1px border. Cardless where possible for data density.
components.inputs: Shadcn standard but customized to have a very light blue/grey background (bg-slate-50) and no thick rings on focus unless necessary.
components.tables: Shadcn tables for Admin. Striped rows for better legibility.
components.charts: Shadcn charts / Recharts for capacity, revenue, and temperature monitoring.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 for standard text. Test text over aquatic background images.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500) for POS terminal usability.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='pos-checkout-btn').

hero_background.description: Blue swimming pool with water, used for hero banner on ticketing site

marketing_card_1.description: Swimming pool tiled floor, good for membership/pass background

feature_slide.description: Water park slide, for family fun and activities section

feature_swim.description: Man doing butterfly stroke underwater, dynamic feature image

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly necessary for core POS/Admin MVP unless specifically showcasing an interactive park map. For standard data, use Recharts. If a 3D park map is desired later, use React Three Fiber.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this guideline meticulously. We are building a hybrid ticketing, POS, and Admin system for a water park / leisure center.
Ensure dual-language support (de/en) structural readiness via i18n placeholders or a toggle.
Build the dashboard and POS interface with dense, clear data, using Shadcn components.
Make sure POS is touch-friendly (large buttons, distinct colors for actions).
Hardware readiness: Mock APIs for RFID/QR wristbands, locker opening/closing, and turnstiles.
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or `<input type='date'>`. Use Shadcn equivalents.
Apply `data-testid` to all buttons and actionable items.
Use light theme as default for this aquatic, family-friendly app.
Integrate provided image URLs gracefully using CSS background-size: cover, overlays (bg-white/20 or bg-black/40) to ensure text readability.
Install Lucide React for consistent iconography.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8). Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute.
